_readme: The ZCode model-response main-reply predicate of the worker. A finished generation carries content beside stopReason. Only the running turn's reply reaches the transcript and context meter. The app server runs side queries for itself. Their text does not belong in the transcript. TestZCodeModelResponseConformance replays these cases against zcodeIsMainReply in the worker. The browser has no copy of the rule because the worker stores no side query. The source words come from contracts/zcode-protocol.json. Without querySource, tool_internal identifies a side query. Every other stop reason identifies the turn reply. A present querySource must be the JSON string main_turn to identify the turn reply.

cases.name: the main turn is the reply
a subagent query is not the reply
a compaction query is not the reply
a goal summary title query is not the reply
a target completion verification query is not the reply
a git commit message query is not the reply
a workspace generate text query is not the reply
an unknown source is not the reply
an absent source with a turn stop reason is the reply
an absent source with the tool-internal stop reason is not the reply
an empty source string is not the reply
a non-string source is not the reply
a null source is present and not the reply beside a turn stop reason
